Subject: Kelridge Office Partners - Quote in Progress

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the submission on Kelridge Office Partners! I've received the application, statement of values, and loss runs for the three locations.

This risk looks like a good fit for our appetite. I'm working on putting together a competitive quote for the January 13th effective date and should have something to you shortly.

I'll reach out if any questions come up during my review, but everything appears complete at this stage.

Thanks for thinking of us on this one!

Best regards,
[Underwriter name]
